# English Intake

> Free online English learning platform with lessons, exercises, and grammar guides for all CEFR levels from A1 to C2.

English Intake provides comprehensive ESL/EFL education through interactive lessons, vocabulary building, grammar instruction, and practice exercises. The platform covers foundational topics like verb conjugation and prepositions alongside advanced grammar concepts, supported by curated book recommendations and printable resources.

## Key Topics

- English grammar
- ESL/EFL learning
- CEFR levels (A1-C2)
- Verb conjugation
- Vocabulary building
- Grammar lessons
- Prepositions
- Sentence structures
- Reading comprehension
- Beginner grammar
- Active and passive voice
- Reported speech
- Past simple tense
- Language learning
- English for Everyone

## Core Learning Resources

- [Learn English online - Free lessons and exercises](https://englishintake.com): English Intake homepage: free lessons and exercises for grammar, vocabulary, and speaking
- [Free English lessons online](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/lessons): ESL lessons covering grammar, conversation, pronunciation, and writing skills
- [English exercises with answers](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/exercises): Interactive grammar, vocabulary, and listening exercises for A1-C2 levels
- [English vocabulary (A1-C2)](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/vocabulary): Vocabulary lessons with pictures and examples for A1-C2 CEFR levels
- [Grammar - From basics to advanced topics](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/grammar): Comprehensive grammar guide covering verbs, sentence structures, and prepositions

## Grammar Reference

- [English conjugator](https://englishintake.com/conjugation): Interactive tool for conjugating English verbs in all tenses and forms
- [Verb be in the affirmative, negative, and interrogative forms](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/be-verb): Grammar lesson on the verb 'to be' as main and auxiliary verb
- [The verb have in English](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/lesson-verb-have): Grammar lesson on verb 'have' for possession and other meanings
- [Prepositions in English](https://englishintake.com/prepositions): Grammar guide on English prepositions covering direction, time, and place
- [Prepositions of time](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/prepositions-of-time): Grammar lesson on prepositions of time with examples and usage rules
- [Active and passive voice - Definition and examples](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/active-and-passive-voice): Grammar lesson comparing active and passive voice sentence structures
- [Reported speech | English grammar](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/lesson-reported-speech): Grammar lesson on reported speech with tense and pronoun changes
- [Possessive case - examples](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/lesson-possessive-case): Grammar lesson on possessive case rules and apostrophe usage
- [There is - There are | Key grammar points](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/lesson-there-is-there-are): Beginner grammar lesson on 'there is' and 'there are' usage

## Beginner Resources

- [English for beginners: reading comprehension](https://englishintake.com/learn-english/english-beginners-reading): Printable reading comprehension worksheets for English beginners in PDF
- [Was - were - Exercises with answers and a printable worksheet](https://englishintake.com/was-were-exercises): Past simple exercises on was/were with printable PDF worksheet
